Fixed 2026-11-21, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#577; borg-reborn-rs #810, PR #835). Exposure
pilot on the 18 fixed starts of classes-18 at 300,000 engine turns (suite classes-18-300k; the regular classes-18 is
untouched), four arms, 72 cells, one binary, evidence retained for all. Every arm sets borg_town_plan 1 and
town_lantern_upgrade_power 0 explicitly and keeps the pinned settings otherwise.
Gate: one binary; each arm's values in params-core.json; no config_error; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or
borg_stopped; stalls, timeouts and crashes kept apart; frozen-turn bursts classified; usable receipts (town-plan.jsonl,
town-departure-fuel.jsonl, messages, transactions, resolved settings, terminal) for every cell.
Report per arm and class: departures with zero usable spare fuel, with no active light and below each fixed fuel
threshold, with equipped light, usable spare torches and remaining fuel; lanterns, permanent lights and characters who
see without fuel apart; naturally found lanterns that change the equipped light counted separately. Restocking
opportunities (fuel deficit, General Store stock and price, usable Home stock, gold after immediate needs, pack room;
cached stock apart from an observed offer), confirmed purchases and spend, Home withdrawals, floor pickups, town deposits,
dungeon disposals, and the reasons affordable stocked deficits remained. Expiry and recovery, lightless episodes or
stops, paired deaths, stalls, level and maximum depth; gold and the early food, Cure Light Wounds, Phase Door and Recall
purchases. How often the arms actually exercised purchasing or retention. Descriptive (RULES 14).
